thread:
incident-bot: PAGE: High 5xx error rate detected for control-plane dependency calls (authz, tenant-resolve, billing). Pager sent to on-call. link: https://dash.reddemo/internal/alerts/2355556677 :rotating_light:

emma: seeing a big spike in 502/504 from gateway -> authz and tenant-resolve. Error-rate ~7.8% across EU/US regions, started ~2355556600.

ben: confirmed, lots of token exchange failures, looks like org resolution timeout (500) is bubbling up. sample trace: `authz->tenant-resolve (timeout 1s) -> gateway 502`.

katie: FYI there was a config-store deploy 3m ago that changed the org-resolution fallback order (new resolver first). Rolling that back as a potential quick mitigation.

emma: logs (truncated):
```
2026-03-15T12:07:23Z ERROR tenant-resolve request_id=abc123 status=500 latency_ms=1203 "ReadTimeout"
2026-03-15T12:07:25Z ERROR authz request_id=def456 status=502 upstream_error=tenant-resolve
```

ben: added a temporary circuit-breaker on calls to tenant-resolve, 30s open, should reduce fanout. Also flipping `ORG_RESOLVER_PRIORITIZE_OLD` flag to true to prefer cached resolver.

ops-bot: Executed cmd: `kubectl set env deployment/ctl-svc ORG_RESOLVER_PRIORITIZE_OLD=true --namespace=prod` at 2355556732.

katie: rollback of config-store completed at 2355556768. Early signal: authz 5xx down from 7.8% -> 4.1% in 30s. still above baseline.

ben: enabling billing-service fallback to stale-balance for non-blocking reads to avoid cascading timeouts. patch applied to billing proxy.

emma: customer-facing impact: token exchange and new session creation failing intermittently, some customer SDK calls returning 5xx. No data loss reported. Major dashboards: https://dash.reddemo/internal/controlplane/errors

raj: I'm taking the pager, joining now. @emma handing off.

raj: running live traces, seeing heavy retries from upstream clients causing spikes. Suggest rate-limit retries at edge and increase internal client backoff. Pushing a config to gateway to throttle retries to 3.

ops-bot: Gateway throttle rule updated at 2355556889: `max_retries=3, backoff_ms=200`

emma: after throttle + rollback + circuit-breaker we see error-rate drop to ~1.6% in US, EU ~2.3%. Still monitoring.

ben: action items: 1) post-incident: run root-cause on config-store deploy + resolver change. 2) add better canary for org-resolver changes. 3) add circuit-breaker defaults for tenant-resolve.

katie: filing incident ticket and will collect rollout diff + deploy job logs.

raj: handing to next oncall in 30m (raj -> ben) — leave channel for 1hr for follow-up.

emma: thanks team. tagging for postmortem: ops, eng-runtime, eng-platform. :thumbsup:

incident-bot: Incident marked: mitigated (partial) — continue monitoring."
